title: dlarray
summary: Create a dlarray compatibility object around host data.
description: `dlarray(X)` wraps host data and optional dimension labels in a RunMat compatibility object.
behaviors: The underlying `Data` value is preserved without conversion.
A second text argument is stored as `Format` and `Labels`.
Additional constructor options and provider-resident gpuArray data are rejected with explicit compatibility errors.
Automatic differentiation and labeled arithmetic are not implemented in this slice.
gpu_residency: `dlarray` currently wraps host values; provider-resident labeled tensor execution remains future work.
